item.title: Push-processed at the Barcelona Blues Festival
item.description:
On 13 July we took the lab out onto the street. Push processing workshop during the Barcelona Blues Festival.

Hector Oca, Álvaro Pascual Bascuñana and Jordi Beitia Gomá photographed the day on Kodak P3200 and developed it the same day. Here are some of the results.
